text:
[Council File 26-0005-S183; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the property at 4056 West 21st Street (Case Nos. 899313, 922470), Assessor I.D. No. 5060-010-032, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
APPROVE the Housing Department (LAHD) report dated October 9, 2026, attached to the Council file, and ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION removing the property at 4056 West 21st Street (Case Nos. 899313, 922470), Assessor I.D. No. 5060-010-032, from the REAP.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LAHD. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Housing Department proposal to take 4056 West 21st Street in Council District 10 off the Rent Escrow Account Program.
